faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Delhi University Part-Time Language Teacher recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Delhi University Part-Time Language Teacher posts is 31st August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Part-Time Language Teacher post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.A., M.A., or a One Year Post Graduate Intensive Advance Diploma Course in Chinese, Japanese, or Korean, along with relevant teaching experience.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, as per the available information, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the Part-Time Language Teacher position?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, attach necessary documents, and send it via post to the address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Part-Time Language Teacher position will be based on an interview. Candidates shortlisted after the initial screening will be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q6. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the Delhi University's official website, specifically the Faculty of Arts (eas.du.ac.in).

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: This is a Part-Time job opportunity at Delhi University.

faq.question: Q8. What are the important dates for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for application submission is 31st August 2026, and the interview is scheduled for 2nd September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Does Delhi University offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Information regarding age relaxation for reserved categories is not explicitly detailed here and should be confirmed by referring to the official notification.

faq.answer: The official website for Delhi University, where you can find more details and download the application form, is https://eas.du.ac.in.
